data.one_liner: Create tutorial overlays to highlight UI components with focus shapes.
data.what_it_does: The tutorial package displays overlay tutorials on top of your existing UI widgets. It allows you to specify GlobalKeys to focus on specific components, define custom shapes like ovals or squares, and navigate through a sequence of tutorial items.
use_when: You need to guide new users through your app's interface features.
You want to highlight specific widgets using oval or square focus shapes.
avoid_when: You need a complex, highly customized state-driven product tour builder.
You require advanced multi-page animation flows beyond simple overlays.
strengths: Easy to set up using GlobalKeys and a list of tutorial items.
Supports oval and square focus shapes.
weaknesses: Relatively old and minimal repository updates.
